digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira adapter mapping seam
propositions: rebar hardcodes Jira project workflow mappings in value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py, preventing support for projects with non-standard statuses, types, or link relations without core edits
the mapping seam must be config-driven, layered (built-in default → config default block → per-project overlay), and provider-neutral so future adapters reuse the core without modification

non-allowed transitions must be handled by replaying the ticket's recorded STATUS event log hops in order; if replay fails or no trail survives (e.g. compacted tickets), the transition drifts with a warning rather than failing
type collapsing requires a symmetric rebar-type label to round-trip safety, and unmapped non-skipped types must fail at config load with fail-closed validation
non-representable parent relationships must drift and leave an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key
required-field create failures must be prevented by a per-project create_defaults config block injected at ticket creation
